plans.gate:
P1 is done when ALL of the following are green on the P1 integration branch and each has a CI run behind it (a gate with no CI run is reported NOT PROVEN, per docs/P0-REPORT.md):

LOCAL/CI COMMANDS (all run in ci.yml on ubuntu-latest, in this order):
1. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` — must be a no-op after the deps task (INV-PLAT-01).
2. `pnpm lint`
3. `pnpm typecheck`
4. `pnpm invariants:check` — docs/invariants.md still the unmodified 424-id corpus copy.
5. `pnpm test` — Vitest + fast-check over projects core, schema, ui, testkit. Every property at PROPERTY_RUNS = 10,000 (zone-looped properties run 10,000 in EACH of the four zones, not 2,500 each); packages/testkit/src/property-gates.test.ts must still fail on any numRuns below the floor and on a scan that finds nothing; packages/testkit/src/arbitraries.test.ts must carry a shape floor for every new generator; packages/core/src/purity.test.ts still green (no react-native imports in packages/core).
6. `pnpm test:golden-migrations` — one committed golden fixture DB per PRAGMA user_version, migrated forward with ROW-LEVEL equality against the expected end state, including the major-version case (INV-PACK-35).
7. `pnpm test:falsify` — executes the committed falsifier input for EVERY owned invariant id and fails if any owned id has no committed falsifier input.
8. `pnpm test:coverage-map` — the union of docs/invariants-owned.json and docs/owned/*.json is exactly P0's six ids plus the 211 P1 ids listed in owned_ids; every one has an owning test whose name carries the id in brackets; no id claimed twice; no id claimed that is absent from docs/invariants.md.
9. `pnpm gitleaks`
10. The headless journey: the 30-day, two-course, four-zone journey test in packages/core/src/journey runs as part of `pnpm test` and passes (run it in a background vitest invocation locally — it exceeds the 180 s foreground limit).

CI JOBS:
- `ci.yml` — green, including the new golden-migration job.
- `native-e2e.yml` — still green and unregressed: flows-present, ios-simulator (Xcode 26.2, the committed patches/expo-modules-jsi@57.1.0.patch intact), android-emulator, prebuild-determinism (INV-PLAT-02). P1 adds no native code; a red native-e2e is a P1 regression.
- `mutation.yml` — nightly Stryker run green against the configured threshold, with the ACTUAL score number recorded in docs/P1-REPORT.md.
- `pack-ci.yml` — unchanged and green.

ARTEFACTS: docs/P1-REPORT.md exists in the shape of docs/P0-REPORT.md, listing the gate clause by clause with evidence or an explicit NOT PROVEN, the numRuns table per property, the per-id owning-test counts, the recorded Stryker score and threshold, dependencies added with resolved versions, deferred items with reasons, and `df -h ~`. No screenshot or device claim without a CI artefact URL.

tasks.brief: RUNS FIRST AND ALONE. The only task in P1 permitted to touch any dependency manifest or lockfile. Read the plan's §Stack table and §Non-negotiables, docs/ci.md (the property floor and the frozen-lockfile install), and ~/duolingo-research/deep/09-build-tooling-facts.md before adding anything. Add, at the repo root with pnpm and workspace-scoped where appropriate: (a) `ts-fsrs` as a dependency of @freelingo/core — it is the FSRS implementation the plan names for scheduler/, and it must be a real dependency, not vendored; (b) a pure-TS ed25519 verifier usable inside the RN bundle (`@noble/ed25519` + `@noble/hashes` for its sha512 hook) as a dependency of @freelingo/schema, because packages/schema/keys/pack-signing.pub must be verified on device where `node:crypto` does not exist — P0's hand-rolled SPKI parser stays and the new verifier is held against `node:crypto` in tests. Do NOT remove or weaken patches/expo-modules-jsi@57.1.0.patch or its pnpm-workspace.yaml `patchedDependencies` entry (INV-PLAT-01/02, the iOS build depends on it). Any Expo package added to apps/mobile goes through `npx expo install` only — P1 is an engine phase and should need none; if you conclude one is needed, say why in blockers rather than adding it. Also create `tools/soundbank/` as a second uv project (`uv init` + `uv add numpy soundfile`, `uv lock`, `uv sync`) for the P1 sound-synthesis script; encoding is done with the already-installed system `ffmpeg` (verified present at /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg; `opusenc` is NOT installed, so libopus via ffmpeg is the path) — do not add a Python audio-codec dependency. Finally, add the npm scripts every other P1 task and the phase gate depend on, so no later task needs to edit root package.json: `test:golden-migrations` (vitest run --project schema -t 'golden'), and confirm `test:falsify`, `test:coverage-map`, `invariants:check` still resolve. Verification, all with run_in_background=true + a log file and short polling (`pnpm install` and `uv sync` both exceed 180 s here): `pnpm install`, then `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` must be a no-op, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` green, `uv sync --project tools/soundbank` and `uv sync --project tools/coursekit` both green. Commit pnpm-lock.yaml and both uv.lock files. Record in the report the exact resolved version of every package added.

The one task allowed to touch packages/schema and packages/core/src/economy/config.ts (plan §The build workflow, step 1); everything else in P1 consumes what you declare here, so land it first and keep its public types stable. Read: plan §Architecture (Data model, Engine table), §Rulings (EC-ECO-01/02, EC-STK-14, EC-FRZ-08, EC-ECO-13), ~/duolingo-research/deep/04-streak-economy-quests-edge-matrix.md in full, deep/02 §Rules and constants and §Freelingo's chosen formulas, deep/00-PRODUCT-MAP.md §3.4 (the ten flavours S057–S066) and Surfaces 8–10, and docs/invariants.md §8 Economy (both the original block at line 142 and the merge-pass block at line 563). Deliver four things. (1) `packages/core/src/types/`: the shared, dependency-free type surface every other P1 module imports — SessionFlavour, ExerciseType, ItemId, CourseId, LocalDay, Verdict, AttemptRow, MistakeRow, PackManifest, CourseProgress, AccountState — declared once so no two modules invent a second spelling. (3) packages/schema: the full progress schema in the two regions account / course_progress[course] with the no-table-straddles gate (INV-ECO-04), the course_display region keyed by course_id (INV-PER-11), the achievement counter registry where every achievement names a column that exists and is incremented by a reachable event (INV-ECO-25/26/28), append-only attempts keyed (session_id, exercise_index), the nine-field session_state row, the migration registry extended past P0's user_version 1 with DDL + PRAGMA user_version in one exclusive transaction (INV-PER-03) and the withExclusiveTransactionAsync grep gate over scheduler and economy modules (INV-PER-07), and the GOLDEN-DB CORPUS: one committed fixture .db per user_version, plus a test named 'golden' that migrates every fixture forward and asserts ROW-LEVEL equality against the expected end state, including the major-version case where no completed node becomes incomplete and account-scoped state is bit-identical (INV-PACK-35). packages/core/src/grading/ — the three-tier checker and everything that decides a verdict. Read: ~/duolingo-research/deep/01-lesson-state-machine.md §S5 (typed translate and the grading model), §S8, §S9, §S13 and §Rules and constants; docs/invariants.md §2 Grading (original block line 54, merge-pass block line 444); 00-EDGE-CASES.md EC-GRD-01…EC-GRD-42; plan §Rulings for EC-GRD-03 (the dropped-token ruling: soft-correct `You missed a word.` when exactly one function-class token is missing, else hard wrong) and EC-GRD-16 (alternate-okurigana headwords join the ja accepted set). Deliver a pure, total, documented grader: tier 1 exact-after-normalisation, tier 2 soft-correct, tier 3 wrong; tier-2 classification TOTAL AND ORDERED — whitespace-insertion → whitespace-omission → capitalisation/terminal punctuation → non-contrastive diacritics → single-edit typo — with a pool of SIX note strings, not four (INV-GRD-01). The three typo guards (not a target-language word · not on the target lexeme · ≥5 chars) are NAMED CONFIG CONSTANTS resolved per pack, and flipping any one must change the verdict on the two recorded failures caso/casa and gatto/gato; a build with the guards inlined must fail the test (INV-GRD-02/15). Authored alternates come from the pack and emit `Another correct solution:` with the preferred rendering — a runtime alternate generator is a test failure (INV-GRD-03), as is the alternate note firing when the matched surface outranks an already-introduced surface (INV-GRD-27). Two independent flags soft_corrected and wrong; a soft-correct never creates a mistake row (INV-GRD-04). Multi-gap is all-or-nothing, no partial credit (INV-GRD-05). The accuracy denominator is the load-bearing one: accuracy = correctFirstTry / scorable where scorable excludes skipped speaking/listening, failed speak attempts, character traces and read/listen-and-respond, and scorable = 0 makes accuracy UNDEFINED and omits the tile — never 0% (INV-GRD-06). A match exercise with ≥1 wrong pair yields exactly one mistake row and one accuracy miss (INV-GRD-07). Pack-parameterised behaviour must be read from the active pack, never a shared map: orthographic_equivalences (INV-GRD-13), spaceless packs (16), reading-vs-surface tier 2 (17), diacritics_contrastive making the diacritic class unreachable (18), the ja tier-1 normalisation as one pure idempotent function with a named dash-fold set (19), register verdict class and register_slot advisories (20/21), word-bank grading as a function of tapped tile ids with a pack-declared join delimiter (23), no_word_delimiter listening compared as baked readings (26), no_word_boundaries highlight ranges plus the grep gate that no Japanese tokenizer is linked into the app (28), and unit-declared punctuation equivalence (29). Build fixture packs for es (Latin, contrastive-diacritic) and ja (spaceless, no_word_boundaries) inside your own lane and drive every property against both. Commit a falsifier input file per invariant id you own, in packages/core/src/grading/__falsifiers__/, and wire them into `pnpm test:falsify`. Do not add dependencies; import types and economy constants from packages/core/src/types and economy, and if something you need is missing there, stub it locally and file it in blockers.

packages/core/src/session/ — queue generation, the shell state machine, resume, quit, combo, interstitials and mistake recycling: the biggest lane in P1 and the one the whole app is a renderer for. Read: ~/duolingo-research/deep/01-lesson-state-machine.md end to end, especially §S0 Session shell, §S14 interstitials, §S15 hard-exercise escalation, §S16 mistake review and the PREVIOUS MISTAKE replay, §S18 quit dialog, §S20 the session-level machine and §Rules and constants; 00-PRODUCT-MAP.md §3.1–§3.4 including the ten flavours table S057–S066; docs/invariants.md §1, §3, §4 (original blocks lines 32/69/82 and merge-pass blocks 425/470/481); the EC-SES-*, EC-COM-*, EC-MIS-* families in 00-EDGE-CASES.md. Deliver: the state machine idle→armed→grading→banner→next with every transition landing in a DECLARED shell state (INV-SESS-22) and one quit contract behind every exit route — X, Android back, hardware back, iOS interactive pop, slide-down dismiss, and every player surface's close control (INV-SESS-14/25). The nine-field resume row (queue, index, answers, hearts, combo, usedInterstitialKeys, inputMode, hardMode, optionSeeds) restored byte-identical from any kill point, never older than one challenge boundary, plus in-flight ungraded input and an opaque per-challenge partial_state (INV-SESS-01/06/15); resume offered iff monotonic age > 24 h, never wall-clock-derived, with backwards jumps clamping to 0 (INV-SESS-02/10). One graded session in flight globally, session_state keyed (course_id, session_kind, node_ref) with ≤1 row per key and story/radio positions in their own rows (INV-SESS-07/09/17). Quit rules: X on the first unanswered exercise writes ZERO rows of any kind (INV-SESS-12); End session and any abandonment commit every answered attempt and mistake to the scheduler while discarding session XP and the ring advance (INV-SESS-11); a session with zero graded attempts writes no session row and no day-keyed reward (INV-SESS-23). Queue generation: no item twice in adjacent positions, length min(target, available), padding from the due pool only (INV-SESS-13), no session below the configured floor and base XP non-decreasing in gradeable items served (INV-SESS-26), zero items from a currently gated family on resume (INV-SESS-16), RESUME offered iff every queued item id resolves in the installed pack and maps to the node (INV-SESS-21), audio availability resolved AT GENERATION so the queue contains zero unplayable items and its length is unchanged (INV-AUD-01), a missing asset degrading exactly one item and never aborting the session (INV-PACK-05), and every exercise-type string the node-type registry can emit having a declared state machine, heart cost and grading rule (INV-PACK-19). The TEN FLAVOURS S057–S066 are a CONFIG TABLE read from packages/core/src/economy's flavour matrix — one runtime, ten configurations — not ten code paths. Combo: +1 per exercise never per pair/gap/stroke, 0 at every session start including Practice/Story/Radio/Hub/recovery, barGold ⟺ combo ≥ 6, label at ≥ 2, interstitials at 5/10/every 10 with a pool of 7 that never repeats copy and never falls back, a single interstitial queue whose render is a duplicate-free subsequence of combo → step-up → mistake-review, and a progress denominator fixed at session start and immutable for the session's life with the reserved final segment consumed exactly once (INV-COM-01…12, INV-SESS-18). Mistakes: recycled exactly twice, once mid-lesson once at the end, retiring only after two correct encounters in OTHER sessions, never reaching complete with a pending mistake, terminating for any answer sequence (a termination proof, not a spot check), and zero recycles and zero queue entries for the three test flavours (INV-MIS-01…08). hardMode is false at every session start for every flavour and a hard item never mutates persisted inputMode (INV-SESS-19/20). The foreground boot sequence is one awaited chain rollover → FSRS recompute → snapshot+reload → notification re-arm publishing no intermediate snapshot (INV-SESS-27). Commit falsifier inputs per invariant under packages/core/src/session/__falsifiers__/. Grading verdicts come from packages/core/src/grading via its interface — do not reimplement a checker; scheduler writes go through packages/core/src/scheduler's interface. Stub across a lane boundary rather than editing another lane, and record every stub in blockers.

packages/core/src/scheduler/ — FSRS and the review pools. The plan calls this 'the one subsystem where a silent fault causes lasting harm rather than a missed reward', so nothing here may be approximated. Read: docs/invariants.md §5 Scheduler (original block line 92, merge-pass block line 586); 00-EDGE-CASES.md EC-SCH-01…EC-SCH-13; ~/duolingo-research/scope2/00-FRAMEWORK-ANSWER.md for the item-id and ledger model; 00-PRODUCT-MAP.md S025 Daily Refresh section, S063 Unit Review, S066 endgame and S092 Today's Review. Build on ts-fsrs (installed by the deps task) — do not hand-roll the algorithm — and wrap it with: the 0.6× early-review guard, where elapsed < 0.6 × scheduled_interval updates retrievability and logs review_kind='early' but leaves stability and due_at UNCHANGED, held by a property that median(interval) is non-decreasing over any 500-review history at any cadence (INV-SCH-01); elapsed_since_last_review clamped to ≥ 0 before it reaches the scheduler, with every clamped event writing an anomaly row, and a property that no adversarial clock sequence can produce a stability increase beyond the honest-clock bound (INV-SCH-02); attempt rows written exactly once per answered exercise keyed (session_id, exercise_index) with idempotent commit replay (INV-SCH-03); the due-backlog rule that surfaces a review session first WITHOUT changing the lesson node's generated contents byte-for-byte (INV-SCH-04); Today's Review and Daily Refresh drawing from ONE pool with a shared per-local_day spent-marker so no item is served by both surfaces on the same day (INV-SCH-05); the endgame generator terminating — non-empty while anything is due, the `Come back later…` state when nothing is, and never introducing an unseen item (INV-SCH-06); reported items generating zero times within 7 local days and accruing zero elapsed over the window (INV-SCH-07); disable-then-enable of a modality advancing ZERO elapsed for held items, so three days with listening off cannot produce a several-hundred-item backlog (INV-SCH-08); displayed Score non-decreasing over any 400-day sequence of reviews, absences, zone changes and clock moves (INV-SCH-09); first-exposure items per local day bounded by max_new_items_per_local_day and no lexeme reaching a production type within min_hours_between_introduction_and_production of its introduction, both read from the economy config (INV-SCH-10); FSRS rows keyed (item, surface) with no surface credited without a prior introduction beat (INV-SCH-11); and ruby-on encounters never changing a grapheme item's stability or due_at (INV-SCH-12). Every property runs on the testkit virtual clock across the four-zone matrix at PROPERTY_RUNS, and the long histories (500 reviews, 400 days) go in a background vitest run with a log file, not the foreground. Commit falsifier inputs per invariant under packages/core/src/scheduler/__falsifiers__/. Consume local_day from packages/core/src/day and constants from economy; do not edit either lane.

packages/core/src/day/ — extend P0's civil-date engine (INV-DAY-01 and INV-DAY-05 are already green; do not regress them) to the whole day boundary, plus freeze and both recovery mechanics. Read: docs/invariants.md §6 and §7 (original blocks lines 107/128, merge-pass blocks 542/552); ~/duolingo-research/deep/04-streak-economy-quests-edge-matrix.md in full; 00-EDGE-CASES.md EC-STK-* and EC-FRZ-*; and the plan's §Rulings, which settle five contradictions you must implement exactly as ruled — EC-FRZ-01 (a freeze is consumed for a missed day IFF it was owned before that day began), EC-STK-02 (a local_day regression is honoured iff UTC is monotonic AND the zone changed), EC-STK-14 (maxRolloverDeferralSeconds = 300, a killed session can never starve rollover), EC-FRZ-08 (BOTH mechanics ship: the 3-lesson recovery challenge with a 2-local-day window AND a monthly Streak Repair at streakRepairsPerMonth = 1, idempotent on (year, month), never stacking with a freeze on the same day, restoring streak = previous_streak with today left unsatisfied — note the old INV-REC-01 grep gate forbidding the string 'Streak Repair' is DELETED), and EC-STK-19 (a frozen day resets the weekly Perfect Streak while the main streak survives). Also implement the corrected INV-DAY-03 exactly: `unlived` is ONLY a date the local clock jumped over via a zone change — a powered-off phone produces lived, missed days that consume a freeze or break the streak like any other, and the falsifier is a three-date powered-off gap that wrongly returns unlived. Deliver: tz_id + local_day stored at both session start and completion with the credited-day preference rule (INV-DAY-04); a break as a RECORDED fact (broken_on, previous_streak) never recomputed from a moving clock (INV-DAY-06); gaps beyond max_offline_days = 30 resolving to one freeze attempt and one break with freeze consumption exactly min(gap_days, freezes_owned, max_offline_days) (INV-DAY-07); the grace window crediting STREAK ONLY, with XP, quests, goal chest and Daily Most XP keyed strictly to completion time (INV-DAY-08); rolloverTo(localDay) idempotent, terminating, deferral bounded by 300 s (INV-DAY-09); achievement and quest predicates evaluated against the tz_id + offset stored on the row and over the set of LIVED days (INV-DAY-10/13); Score, gems and lifetime XP invariant under every clock and zone manipulation in the matrix (INV-DAY-11); quest progress keyed to local_day with a countdown that may lengthen but never shorten below the true remaining time (INV-DAY-12); the 1970-install / pre-build-date guard (INV-DAY-14); credited_local_day written ONCE at the S1a commit under the session_id idempotency key and reproduced by every later rollover (INV-DAY-15); monthly settlements equalling distinct YYYY-MM values over any 400-day four-zone trace (INV-DAY-16); and local_day identical for every tz_id string sharing one offset, Etc/GMT-5 and UTC included, with tz_source recorded (INV-DAY-17). Freeze: the rollover walk per EC-FRZ-01 with freezes_consumed = min(missed_days, freezes_owned_at_absence_start) over any absence (INV-FRZ-01); frozen days preserving but not incrementing the streak and not arming the challenge (INV-FRZ-02); three acquisition channels plus the one_time subtype, each idempotent on its own grant key, balance never above cap (INV-FRZ-03); Society tier entry granting freezes idempotently on society_tier_entered_at so a clock-tamper replay mints nothing (INV-FRZ-04); each civil day's rollover decision as ONE exclusive transaction over (freeze decrement, day disposition, last_processed_day) keyed by the day it covers so replay is a no-op (INV-FRZ-05); and every grant clamping to cap − held with a zero-effect grant producing no ceremony screen and no copy (INV-FRZ-06). Recovery: INV-REC-01…07 including the two-local-day window, eligibility as a function of session START time only, arming iff the break is inside the recency window and uncovered missed days are inside the cap, and a restore repainting exactly the uncovered dates as `recovered` with at most one milestone screen. Every property on the virtual clock across the four zones at PROPERTY_RUNS; run the 400-day traces in a background vitest run with a log file. Commit falsifier inputs per invariant under packages/core/src/day/__falsifiers__/.

packages/core/src/path/ and packages/core/src/ceremony/ — node state as a pure function, and the reward commit. Read: ~/duolingo-research/deep/03-path-sections-units-nodes.md and deep/02-lesson-complete-and-rewards.md in full, especially deep/02 §S1…§S16, §The ceremony queue (the actual control flow) and §Freelingo's chosen formulas; docs/invariants.md §9 and §10 (original blocks lines 164/180, merge-pass blocks 529/507); 00-PRODUCT-MAP.md Surface 2 (S010–S028) and Surface 4 (S067–S090); EC-PTH-* and EC-CER-* in 00-EDGE-CASES.md; and the plan's rulings EC-PTH-21 (node unlock is linear within a unit AND unit n+1 unlocks only when the last node of unit n is complete, no early unlock on the first level, proven by a property over generated paths) and EC-CER-14 (after 5 consecutive goal-met days S078+S080 collapse into a row on S067 ONLY when the bundle is gems-only; any freeze, boost or tier grant keeps its full screen). PATH: node visual state as a pure function of (sub_lessons_done, sub_lessons_total, legendary) with no timer, decay or server input (INV-PATH-02); the complete-node popup exposing Practice and, if eligible, Legendary, and never a sub-lesson counter or START (INV-PATH-03); failing Legendary or a jump-here changing no persistent state except an attempt log with a free immediate retry (INV-PATH-04); the unit trophy legendary iff every level in the unit is legendary, folding only over node types that declare a LEGENDARY offer against a pack-declared denominator, and ignoring letters levels (INV-PATH-05/16/25); the Score floor — a passed jump-here marks skipped items UNSEEN in FSRS and raises score_floor, displayed_score = max(score_earned, score_floor), score_floor non-decreasing, CEFR chip and Score chip never disagreeing by more than one band (INV-PATH-06), with section-level Score a non-decreasing clamp of the course Score into that section's band (INV-PATH-22); the demotion offer firing at most once per node and at most once per 7 local days (INV-PATH-07/14); Daily Refresh locked iff the course is incomplete and unlocking exactly once (INV-PATH-08); an absence of any length changing NO path state (INV-PATH-09); the jump-here node existing iff its target unit is locked (INV-PATH-13); reachability — from every reachable path state and every goal tier a streak-extending session within that tier's exercise budget is reachable in ≤ 2 taps or the blocking node exposes a defer control (INV-PATH-15); every flavour-enum value reachable from a shipped entry point with sectionTest resolving to the S019 section-boundary variant rather than its own node type (INV-PATH-17); every node type declaring a completed-popup shape whose buttons map only to flavours that node can launch (INV-PATH-18); every generated node having a completion path on the device that generated it, proven with the LLM capability stubbed absent (INV-PATH-19); section fraction counting only fully-complete units and unitCompleted firing only on an incomplete→complete transition (INV-PATH-20); completion predicates firing only on a state transition with the post-ceremony viewport equal to the launching viewport (INV-PATH-21); no placed node pointing backwards and Unit Rewind paying at most once per unit per local_day regardless of entry point (INV-PATH-23); no unintroduced script_unit appearing after any placement or passed jump-here, with every letters node still reachable and required (INV-PATH-26); and the node-type registry being PACK-DRIVEN, so a pack declaring no stories yields a path with no book nodes and no empty states anywhere (INV-PACK-03), with completion copy, the section list and the Score ceiling all functions of the manifest (INV-PACK-56). CEREMONY: extend P0's INV-CER-01 (its two properties currently draw ids from fc.string() so the ledger-collision branch is never hit by the property — fix that first by drawing from a small id pool so collisions are common, as the P0 report requires), then deliver the ordered predicate queue evaluated ONCE whose rendered chain is a duplicate-free subsequence of the canonical order with the path model mutated before the return screen renders (INV-CER-02); streakExtendedThisSession and streakAlreadyExtendedToday mutually exclusive and jointly exhaustive (INV-CER-04); the Perfect-lesson single-COMBO-tile terminal layout firing only for lesson flavours (INV-CER-05); the consolation screen for a failed gated challenge and no ceremony for a genuinely zero-award abandonment (INV-CER-06); at most one achievement screen per session at the highest tier crossed with all crossed tiers' gems summed into one chest, Personal Records updating with no screen (INV-CER-07/INV-ECO-23 boundary); ceilingReachedThisSession firing exactly once in a course's lifetime (INV-CER-08); ONE reward-screen component over a bundle {gems?, freeze?, boost?} with copy selected by bundle contents and no second gems-only screen (INV-CER-09, the bundle reward selection, extended by the EC-CER-14 collapse rule); legendaryTakeoverEligible false after two consecutive declines until a section boundary or an accepted run (INV-CER-10); exposure_fraction strictly increasing and mastery_score non-decreasing forever (INV-CER-11); `Skip all` producing a byte-identical committed ledger with every one-time screen still rendered (INV-CER-13); the S5 picker at most once per streak run and permanently false after two un-picked presentations via a DECLINED sentinel distinct from null (INV-CER-14); the resolved S1b two-tile registry with no CeremonyTile variant declaring a time or COMMITTED slot (INV-CER-15); and a Score tick-over plus a CEFR band crossing contributing exactly one entry at the Score slot (INV-CER-17). The single exclusive commit stays the one place rewards are written. Commit falsifier inputs per invariant under each module's __falsifiers__/ directory.

packages/core/src/packs/, data/ and security/ — the pack lifecycle harness, export/import and the two security gates. This is the P1 HARNESS half of §13/§14; the coursekit content gates (the C-kind INV-PACK ids) belong to P2 and must NOT be claimed here. Read: docs/invariants.md §13 and §14 (original blocks lines 233/251, merge-pass blocks 626/641) and §19 (line 332); the plan's §Architecture Data model paragraph on the six-value pack enum and signing; ~/duolingo-research/scope2/05-on-device-persistence-no-accounts.md; ~/duolingo-research/deep/10-content-pipeline-per-language-facts.md for the manifest shape; 00-EDGE-CASES.md EC-PER-*, EC-PACK-* and EC-SEC-*; the plan ruling EC-PER-08 (imported gap days count as MISSED, never unlived, and the confirm dialog states the freeze cost before it is paid); and packages/schema/src/signing.ts plus its P0 test, which you extend rather than replace. Deliver: the SIX-state pack enum {not-downloaded, partial, installed, corrupt, unverified, withdrawn} as a total state machine where an invalid signature maps to `unverified` and NEVER to `corrupt`, and a withdrawn pack keeps its course read-only with account-scoped totals intact (INV-PACK-01); ed25519 signature verification BEFORE install, using packages/schema/keys/pack-signing.pub through the pure-TS verifier the deps task installed — held against node:crypto for agreement and shown to reject a wrong key, a truncated signature and a tampered manifest (INV-PACK-18); partial ≠ corrupt, with a partial pack keeping path and lessons fully usable under per-item audio fallback and offering RESUME while only corrupt shows the unavailable state (INV-PACK-04); content-hashed, additive-only item ids within a major version, and on a major bump unresolvable FSRS rows QUARANTINED not deleted, no longer counting toward Score or words-learned and counted in the update notice (INV-PACK-02); and an evicted installed pack resolving to not-downloaded on switch with no fetch started on a metered connection without an explicit confirm (INV-PACK-27). Persistence: on SQLITE_CORRUPT or a failed integrity_check the app renames-never-deletes under freelingo-corrupt-*, starts a fresh DB and lands on the Data screen, proven by corrupting a byte range in a fixture DB (INV-PER-01); rolloverTo() has an integrity precondition so a failed-integrity DB consumes no freeze and breaks no streak (INV-PER-02); commit write order is attempts+mistakes → rewards, with SQLITE_FULL suppressing the ceremony, held by the property that THE CEREMONY NEVER DISPLAYS A REWARD THAT IS NOT IN THE DB (INV-PER-04); availableDiskSpace is checked at session start through an injected probe, below threshold the resume guarantee is downgraded VISIBLY, and a failed boundary write sets a flag rather than failing silently (INV-PER-05); and below the backup requirement no DDL runs at all while the blocking screen still exposes export and audio removal (INV-PER-08). Export/import: temp path → checksum into the manifest → share sheet only on a verified-complete write, a failed export leaving no artefact (INV-DAT-01); import is replace-only, refuses a downgrade, takes a pre-import backup, shows both last_day values plus sessions-since-install, keeps the backup 24 h behind one-tap undo, and is reachable from onboarding S003 (INV-DAT-02); session_state excluded from the archive and the manifest saying so (INV-DAT-03); historical rows never re-stamped, imported gap days missed not unlived (INV-DAT-04); a future max_local_day_seen never suppressing a day-keyed reward on the next honest-clock session (INV-DAT-05); a missing -wal detected as an INCOMPLETE RESTORE rather than opened silently, with every export/backup path checkpointing first (INV-DAT-07); import never writing any economy-config field and never resolving a pack id absent from this build, with the manifest parsed without opening the dump (INV-DAT-09); and a property over arbitrary syntactically-valid archives that post-import state is within declared ranges, max_local_day_seen ≤ today, achievements are recomputed from counters and the next session still grants its goal chest (INV-DAT-10). Security: INV-SEC-01 as corrected by the plan — EVERY user-text field (typed answers, the tier-3 diff, report notes, and the read-and-respond/Roleplay inputs) is bidi-stripped, format-character-stripped, NFC-normalised and length-capped AT STORAGE TIME not at render, with a property that the stored value contains no bidi-control or Cf character, grading is invariant under inserted zero-width characters, and surrounding UI order is unchanged; and INV-SEC-02, a grep gate over the WHOLE codebase that execAsync is never called with interpolated input (use packages/testkit's repo helpers, and make the gate fail when it scans nothing — the P0 report records that a scan finding nothing passes for free, and that it must skip generated ios/android trees by PATH not by directory name). Commit falsifier inputs per invariant under each module's __falsifiers__/ directory. Do not edit packages/schema (that lane belongs to p1-foundation-economy-schema); import from it and file any missing table in blockers.

The phase gate made executable. Lands LAST in the merge queue: rebase onto every merged P1 branch before your final run, because you are the only task that sees the whole engine at once. Read the plan's P1 gate row and §Verification, docs/ci.md (the property floor, why the per-project vitest timeout exists, and that only CI writes e2e/artifacts), docs/P0-REPORT.md (the format and the honesty standard — a gate with no CI run behind it is listed as NOT PROVEN, not as done), and docs/README.md §Adding coverage. Deliver four things. (1) The HEADLESS 30-DAY TWO-COURSE FOUR-ZONE JOURNEY as a test in packages/core/src/journey/: a single driver on the testkit virtual clock that installs two courses, runs 30 simulated local days across the four-zone matrix (+9, −7/−8, +14, Lord Howe), and exercises the real modules end to end — onboarding-equivalent state, session generation, grading, the ceremony commit, rollover, a freeze walk, a missed day, a recovery challenge, a monthly Streak Repair, a goal change mid-day, a course switch with a parked session, a boost that expires past boostGraceSeconds, a kill-and-resume at a random instant, a pack major bump with quarantined rows, and an export→wipe→import round trip. It asserts end-state ledgers rather than screenshots, and every day's rollover is replayed once to prove idempotence. Run it in a BACKGROUND vitest invocation with a log file; it will exceed 180 s. (2) The falsifier corpus gate: `pnpm test:falsify` must actually execute the committed __falsifiers__ inputs from all eight module lanes and FAIL if any owned invariant id has no committed falsifier input — the same failure mode docs/ci.md warns about, where a scan that finds nothing passes for free. (3) The coverage gate: docs/owned/journey.json plus a check that the union of docs/invariants-owned.json and every docs/owned/*.json equals exactly the 211 ids this phase owns plus P0's six, that every one of them has an owning test whose name carries the id in brackets, and that no id is claimed twice or claimed while absent from docs/invariants.md. (4) Stryker: tune stryker.config.json and .github/workflows/mutation.yml to cover packages/core's new modules, run the nightly job, and RECORD THE ACTUAL SCORE plus the threshold in docs/P1-REPORT.md — a recorded number, never 'the mutation job is green'. Write docs/P1-REPORT.md in the shape of docs/P0-REPORT.md: the gate clause by clause with evidence or an explicit NOT PROVEN, the numRuns table per property, the owned-id count with per-id owning-test counts, what each task deferred and why, dependencies added (none, by this task), the disk reading from `df -h ~`, and the open items carried into P2. Do not modify any module lane; if the journey exposes a defect, report it as a refutation for that lane's owner rather than patching across the boundary.

  V8 records grammar_engine / spellcheck_engine / perplexity_engine actually used; "0 errors with no engine" fails  [INV-PACK-14]
  zero UNRESOLVED licences; every attribution-required sentence row carries a non-empty owner string  [INV-PACK-13, INV-PACK-17, V10]
  no NC/ND corpus reached the ledger, proven by a zero-network-call test on the forbidden list       [INV-PACK-13]
  audio manifest declares codec=opus, bitrate=20kbps, and total bytes for lessons + stories placeholder + radio placeholder <= 120 MB  [INV-PACK-15]
  manifest declares ledger_unit=lemma exactly once and no consumer inlines its own token notion       [INV-PACK-40]
  every missable item carries >= 2 authored forms                                                     [INV-PACK-07]
  wrong-item rate recorded as PROVISIONAL (unreviewed by a paid native speaker), on the pack card and in docs/pack-provenance.md

tasks.brief: Read the plan's §Content pipeline and P2 row, docs/ci.md, tools/coursekit/README.md, scope2/00-FRAMEWORK-ANSWER.md §2.1–2.5, and deep/10 §S1–S9 plus its Rules table and the adversarial review R1–R19 (ten stated constants there are WRONG — R1 LanguageTool ja is 735 grammar rules and no spellcheck, R2 NLLB v1 is ODC-By not unlicensed, R3 the CC0 file is uppercase sentences_CC0.tar.bz2, R8 JParaCrawl is non-commercial-by-default and forbidden, R13 the 35–40 MB bank is arithmetically impossible hence the plan's 120 MB re-declaration). You run FIRST and ALONE and you are the only task in P2 allowed to change pyproject.toml, uv.lock, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm-workspace.yaml. Install every dependency the phase needs with `uv add` in tools/coursekit: default group typer, httpx, pyyaml, jsonschema, pynacl (ed25519 for `coursekit sign`, matching packages/schema/src/signing.ts's 44-byte SPKI contract), regex; group `nlp` spacy 3.8.x plus the es_core_news_md 3.8.0 wheel pinned BY URL not by name (deep/10 S3: `spacy download` resolves against a live manifest and a lemmatiser change silently re-partitions the ledger — a V1 hazard); group `lm` kenlm from the GitHub archive; group `align` simalign+torch-cpu+transformers; group `tts` kokoro-onnx+soundfile+numpy. Only `nlp` and `lm` are synced by CI — `align` and `tts` are too heavy for a 20-minute ubuntu job, so record that decision in tools/coursekit/docs/pipeline.md and make every stage that needs them fail loudly when the group is absent rather than degrade silently. Second and equally load-bearing job: because the phase runs as two waves and eight lanes cannot consume each other's live output, you define the frozen inter-stage artefact contract — artifacts.py with one JSON-schema'd record per G-stage boundary (ingested sentence, analysed sentence, banded lemma, unit assignment, selected item, candidate, exercise, baked clip, pack row), a run directory layout under build/<lang>/gN/, runlog.py for the per-stage provenance log every downstream validator reads, and inputs.py, the single place a missing per-language data source is resolved. Then author tools/coursekit/tests/fixtures/es-mini/ — roughly 200 ORIGINAL es/en pairs you write yourself (never copied from Cervantes, Duolingo or a corpus), each carrying a licence row and an attribution owner, plus a matching mini frequency list and mini band table — so that every other lane can build and test against a real fixture in wave 2. Convert config.py into a config/ package with base.py (shared constants only) and empty per-stage submodules each owned by another lane; keep the README rule that no literal lives outside config/. Wire cli.py + commands/ as thin dispatchers over a stage and validator registry so later lanes register themselves without editing your files, and make an unregistered stage exit 2, never 0. Commit the lockfiles. Every other P2 task lists NO dependency change.

Read deep/10 §S1 (G0 ingest) and §S2 (G0b licensing gate) in full, its Rules and constants table, its Edge cases 1–6, the adversarial review R2/R3/R4/R8, invariants INV-PACK-12 and INV-PACK-13 in docs/invariants.md, and the plan's non-negotiable that INV-PACK-13 is a P2 ENTRY CRITERION: the allow-list config exists and is consulted before G0 reads a byte. Build G0 for Spanish: Tatoeba per-language exports for `spa` (sentences_detailed for the owner and dates that V10 needs, plus eng_sentences and the spa-eng links file, joined on id — the per-pair export is ids only) and a CAPPED, STREAMED OPUS/NLLB pull at --max-pairs 2000000 through the OPUS API (`opus.nlpl.eu/opusapi/?corpus=…&source=en&target=es&preprocessing=moses&version=latest`), never the 40.3 GB full en-es download. The licence allow-list is the spine of this lane and must be structurally impossible to bypass: `corpora_shippable` is an allow-list, anything unclassified fails, NC and ND sources are excluded AT INGEST rather than filtered at package time, and your test must prove that a forbidden corpus produces zero network calls (assert on a mock transport that was never invoked) — not merely zero output rows. TED2020 is CC BY-NC-ND and forbidden outright; JParaCrawl is non-commercial-by-default (R8) and forbidden; OpenSubtitles and CCMatrix are oracle-only, usable for frequency/perplexity/alignment statistics and never shipped verbatim; NLLB v1 carries ODC-By (R2) and is the plan's shippable selection corpus alongside Tatoeba, with attribution recorded per sentence. Encode the uppercase `sentences_CC0.tar.bz2` filename fact and its per-language form `spa_sentences_CC0.tsv.bz2`, and record in your report that the Spanish CC0 subset is 2,266 compressed bytes (R4) and therefore not a route to avoiding the credits screen. Also encode that OPUS pair codes are ISO-639-1 sorted alphabetically (en-es here, but de-en for P7's German) and that a 404 is a hard build failure naming the correct direction, never a silent fallback to another corpus. INV-PACK-12 is yours: every missing per-language input fails loudly through the scaffold's inputs.py with the missing input NAMED, and no code path can substitute a differently-shaped file. Emit per-sentence rows carrying corpus, version, resolved licence string, the legacy licence page URL it was resolved from, and the attribution owner; a sentence whose licence resolves to UNRESOLVED must never reach the ledger. All fetches and any corpus download go through the Bash tool with run_in_background=true and a log file.

Read deep/10 §S3 (G1 morphology adapters) and §S4 (G2 frequency + CEFR) with adversarial notes R9 and R23, scope2/00-FRAMEWORK-ANSWER.md §2.3 rows G1/G2 and Q2, and invariants INV-PACK-40 and INV-PACK-51. Build G1 for Spanish on spaCy 3.8 es_core_news_md installed from the wheel URL the deps lane pinned: segment, lemmatise and emit a morph-feature bundle plus UD POS per token on both sides, and an adapter self-test corpus that fails if the lemmatiser's output for a fixed sentence list ever changes (a silent lemmatiser swap retro-introduces lemmas before their unit and makes V1 pass vacuously). Build G2: rank lemmas by frequency from hermitdave FrequencyWords content/2018/es/es_50k.txt, pushing its SURFACE forms through your own G1 adapter before they touch the ledger — hermitdave's lists are not lemmatised — and record in the artefact that the derived ordering is CC BY-SA-4.0 and therefore declared share-alike in the manifest. Band each lemma against ELELex (ELELex.tsv, FreeLing POS, mapped via freeling_to_elelex.yaml, 14,290 entries), which is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and is used HERE ONLY BECAUSE the packs themselves ship CC BY-NC-SA per the plan's licence split — write that reasoning into config/g2.py next to the constant so nobody later copies the dependency into AGPL code, and make the band a per-lemma sanity check, never the source of the section CEFR label (R23: the section label is a G3 output). INV-PACK-40 is the load-bearing one and it is bigger than one file: declare ledger_unit = lemma for Spanish exactly once, expose it through ledger.py, and own a grep-style test over the whole tools/coursekit tree that fails if any consumer — the length filter, the new-item budget, V1/V2, or the stored speaking tokens — carries its own inlined notion of a token. Also declare the pack's own recycling window and new-item budget here, and report mean content-words-per-sentence. INV-PACK-51: no two distinct ledger items may share a (normalized_form, reading_form, POS) key; for Spanish reading_form is the orthographic form, and the falsifier is a homograph pair collapsing to one Words row. Model downloads and any spaCy install run with run_in_background=true into a log.

Read scope2/00-FRAMEWORK-ANSWER.md §2.2 (the language-agnostic curriculum template, which is also the D1 tagging contract) and §2.4 rows V1–V4, deep/01 §Ordering (recognition before production; the published 5–7 new words per lesson budget), deep/00-PRODUCT-MAP.md S023/S024 (section list and section details: `{{cefr_level}} • see details`, the CEFR prose, the Grammar concepts list — and note only seven prose values ship, with NO A2 string), deep/10 R23, and INV-PACK-06. Two jobs. First, AUTHOR content/es/curriculum.yaml yourself: roughly ten Section-1 units with original can-do titles in the register of "Order at a café", each with function, grammar_concept, target_lexemes and register_slot; 25–30 grammar concepts; ~1,000 target lexemes for A1 in total. Every word of it is yours — copying Cervantes' Plan Curricular wording or Duolingo's unit titles is the one failure this file can have that no test catches, so say in content/es/README.md that it is originally authored and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Second, build G3 as a CONSTRAINT SOLVER, not an LLM: assign banded lemmas and grammar concepts to units under the template subject to the new-item rate and the recycling constraint, and emit the section CEFR label as a G3 OUTPUT (which grammar concepts a section contains), checked against the G2 lexicon rather than looked up from it. Then G4: for each lesson slot select corpus sentences whose lemma set is a subset of known ∪ this unit's new items and which exhibit the unit's grammar concept, filtering on corpus.shippable so no oracle-only sentence can be picked, and emit an explicit gap list for the G5 lane. You own validators V1–V4 because they are assertions about the ledger you produce: V1 no lemma appears in any exercise before its introduction unit (lemma-level, never surface token); V2 at most one new lemma-or-inflection per exercise and at most K new lemmas per lesson; V3 every introduced lemma reappears at least N times within K lessons; V4 tag soundness and coverage — every exercise's tags are a subset of the lemmas actually present, and every unit's target_lexemes appear in at least one exercise. Also own V9 (no duplicate sentence hash within a unit, cross-unit repeats under the configured ceiling). INV-PACK-06 is the claim that V1–V4 pass at 100% on the built pack, so its test must run them over the es-mini fixture AND fail on a deliberately corrupted ledger; ship the falsifier input. Report the measured yield — what fraction of short candidates the ledger admits — because deep/10 Open Question 1 calls that the most load-bearing untested assumption in the content plan and P2 is where it stops being untested.

Read deep/10 §S5 (G5 gap-fill) and §S6 (G6 validate), the adversarial review R1 (LanguageTool's Japanese row was read backwards — the ✓ the spec called "grammar checks" is the SPELL CHECK column, and the quoted sentence is about Norwegian; Spanish has 1,644 XML grammar rules and its own spellcheck answer, so re-derive what V8 degrades to rather than copying the table), R17 and R18, scope2/00-FRAMEWORK §2.3 rows G5/G6, and invariants INV-PACK-10 and INV-PACK-14. THERE ARE NO API KEYS IN THIS ENVIRONMENT, so the plan's ruling stands: YOU, an Opus agent, are the author. Write the gap-fill candidates yourself into content/es/candidates.jsonl — for each slot the G4 gap list cannot fill, over-generate roughly twenty candidates constrained to the slot's closed vocabulary, each carrying its slot id, the allowed lemma set it was written against, and provenance `llm` so the manifest's machine-authored percentage is real. Then build G5 as pure generate-and-reject: every candidate re-enters the pipeline through the SAME path as a corpus sentence, and V1/V2 reject out-of-vocabulary candidates in microseconds. INV-PACK-10 is the hard structural rule and it is a grep gate as much as a test: content that fails a filter axis is DISCARDED AND RESAMPLED, never patched, and no repair path may exist anywhere in the generator — your test greps your own stage for any edit-in-place branch and fails on one. Build G6: KenLM perplexity band trained on the OpenSubtitles/CCMatrix oracle text (a language model is a statistic, not a redistribution — which is exactly why oracle-only corpora are the right training text), LanguageTool Spanish run against a LOCAL Java server started as a build-time sidecar (LGPL is fine out-of-process, never linked into the app) with the public API explicitly forbidden for batch work, and a back-translation consistency check that, with no hosted model available, is YOUR OWN judgement recorded as a rubric score — define the rubric in content/es/gapfill-rubric.md, score into the candidate rows, and be explicit in the artefact that the score is agent-authored, not a model round-trip. Tests must run against engines/mock_lt.py, a local mock server, so pytest needs neither Java nor a jar. INV-PACK-14 is V8's honesty gate: record which engines ACTUALLY RAN per language (`grammar_engine`, `spellcheck_engine`, `perplexity_engine`) and degrade to the NAMED fallback; a validator that reports "0 errors" when no engine ran must FAIL, and that is the falsifier to commit. Train KenLM and start the LT server with run_in_background=true and a log file — both exceed the 180-second stall limit.

Read deep/01-lesson-state-machine.md §S1–S11 (every exercise type, its instruction strings, its grading contract and its heart cost) and its §Ordering and §Rules tables, deep/00-PRODUCT-MAP.md S032–S041, scope2/00-FRAMEWORK §2.3 row G7 and §2.4 rows V4/V5/V6, deep/10 §S7 (SimAlign) with adversarial note R16, and invariants INV-PACK-07, INV-PACK-08 and INV-PACK-50. Expand each selected or authored pair into the exercise shapes Freelingo ships at A1: picture-select, match pairs, meaning select, word-bank translate in BOTH directions, typed translate, complete the chat, the listening family (tap what you hear, type what you hear, listen for the missing word), the gap-fill family, read/listen-and-respond, and speak. S043 `Put the events in order` is OUT of v1 by founder ruling — assert that no code path can emit it. Distractors come from the RULE CORE — same POS, same frequency band, and morphological wrong-form — with an LLM only ever as a re-ranker; since no hosted model exists here, ship the rule core and leave the re-rank hook unimplemented and unreachable rather than faking it. done: packs/state.ts — the SIX-value enum {not-downloaded, partial, installed, corrupt, unverified, withdrawn} as a TOTAL function from observable facts (catalogue, dbPresent, signature, integrity, audio bytes) plus a total `applyPackEvent`. Facts rather than an accumulated transition log, because the OS can evict a pack while the app is not running and no transition is ever observed. The RULE ORDER is the invariant: `signature === 'invalid'` is tested before `integrity === 'failed'`, so no arrangement of facts can map a bad signature to `corrupt` (property over 10,000 generated fact sets). `packSurface` is one table all surfaces read, with a distinct copyKey and exactly one action per state.

packs/install.ts — verify-before-install. `installPack` returns the ordered `steps` it ran, so a correct implementation is distinguishable from one that installs first and checks after; `install` never appears when the signature or the payload digest fails. `unverified` is framed as a PRE-install fact (these bytes are not ours) and `corrupt` as a POST-install fact (verified bytes that later rotted), so `installPack` can never return `corrupt` for ANY input — asserted directly over seven mutations.

packs/ed25519.ts — a dependency-free RFC 8032 verifier (extended-coordinate Edwards arithmetic, strongly-unified addition, cofactorless check, non-canonical-S rejection), total: every malformed input is `false`, never a throw. Held against node:crypto on 24 generated key pairs × 4 messages in both directions, and shown rejecting a wrong key, a truncated signature (0/1/32/63 bytes), a one-bit-tampered manifest (10,000 cases), a tampered signature in R and in S, a malformed/off-curve public key, and a non-canonical S that node:crypto also rejects. The committed packages/schema/keys/pack-signing.pub is read through readRepoFile and rejects a pack signed by anyone else.

packs/hashing.ts — SHA-256 and SHA-512 with no dependencies (Hermes has neither node:crypto nor WebCrypto subtle). Both agree with node:crypto over 10,000 generated inputs each, on the FIPS 180-4 vectors, and at every block boundary (0/55/56/63/64/111/112/127/128/129/256 bytes). Round constants are DERIVED — `icbrt(p << 192) mod 2^64` — not pasted, because eighty hand-copied hex literals are eighty chances to ship a subtly wrong hash.

artifacts.py — the frozen inter-stage contract. INV-PACK-13 is implemented as a CAPABILITY, not a check. `IngestPermit.__init__` demands a module-private token, so the only way to get one is `sources.licences.permit()`, which refuses (a) verdict `forbidden`, (b) a licence off `INGEST_LICENCE_ALLOW_LIST`, (c) a licence with no page it was resolved from (-> UNRESOLVED). Every fetcher takes a permit; `open_transport(permit, inner, hosts=...)` is the only way to obtain something a fetcher can call get/stream on; `require()` re-derives the verdict from config.SOURCES before EVERY request, not once per run; and GatedTransport refuses a URL whose host is not the source's. A forbidden corpus therefore produces zero network calls, which is what the tests assert against a transport that records every URL.

INV-PACK-12 is the Tatoeba reader plus inputs.py: three per-language exports joined on id (the per-pair export is ids only), `spa_sentences_detailed.tsv.bz2` (owner + dates, which V10 needs) never substituted by `spa_sentences.tsv.bz2`, an EXACT column-count check in both directions, and every 404 raised as a MissingInput naming the file. Read order is links -> eng -> detailed so a missing alignment stops before the 9.5 MB text download.

OPUS/NLLB is read with RANGED requests rather than streamed, because a moses archive holds one member per side and the second starts after the first ends: streaming to the Spanish side of en-es.txt.zip means reading 40,327,884,789 bytes. It reads the central directory from the tail (zip64 handled - every archive worth capping is >4 GB), then the front of each member in 8 MB slices, stopping at --max-pairs (default 2,000,000).

Encoded, with the adversarial-review id at each row in tools/coursekit/src/coursekit/config/g0.py: uppercase `sentences_CC0.tar.bz2` and `spa_sentences_CC0.tsv.bz2` (R3); TATOEBA_CC0_COMPRESSED_BYTES = spa 2266 / deu 1852 / jpn 228 / fra 313297 with `cc0_is_a_viable_pool()` true only for fra (R4); OPUS pair codes ISO-639-1 sorted alphabetically with a 404 as a hard failure naming the direction and no fallback (edge case 1); OPUS_STALE_SIZE_SOURCES so NLLB's `size` field is never used for a decision (R2); TED2020 and JParaCrawl forbidden, OpenSubtitles/CCMatrix refused as unclassified NOASSERTION (R8, EC-PACK-09/10/11).

INV-AUD-08 clause 1 — the bake MEASURES the shipped file. Chain: synthesise → normalise → look-ahead peak-limit → encode at 20 kbps → DECODE the .opus → measure → correct the PCM gain by the error → re-encode, until it converges inside half the declared tolerance. tts/loudness.py is a numpy-only ITU-R BS.1770-4 gated meter, calibrated rather than trusted: the derived 48 kHz coefficients reproduce the published table to eleven places and a 1 kHz sine at −20 dBFS RMS reads −19.993 LUFS. Target −16.0 LUFS ±0.5 LU, matching deep/08 §12's sound-bank figure so a sting and the line before it sit at one level (EC-PACK-52).

Two measured findings forced that chain, both caught by the stage's own gate, not by reading. (1) Kokoro's Spanish output has a 16–21 dB crest factor (measured: 16.6, 20.9, 16.0 dB), so scale-and-obey-the-ceiling shipped 23 of 23 clips 5–6 LU flat — EC-PACK-52's −19.6 LUFS voice bank reached by another route; hence the limiter, with its per-clip gain reduction recorded in the manifest. (2) A 20 kbps Opus encode then costs a further 0.37–0.75 LU systematically; widening the tolerance would have made INV-AUD-08 true by declaration, so the loop closes on the encoded file instead.

G5 (stages/g5_gapfill.py) is pure generate-and-reject. Five axes in evaluation order — stale_ledger, out_of_vocabulary, new_lemma_budget, length, duplicate. Rejected candidates are written, not dropped, so the reject rate has a real denominator. A slot authored below the 20-candidate floor fails the stage; a slot whose pool is exhausted fails the stage with the slot named — never filled by the least-bad rejected candidate.
